perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.desc: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.desc: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Balanced Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.

perks.name: Burst Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.

perks.name: Enduring Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

perks.name: Swordmaster's Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.

perks.name: Vortex Frame
perks.desc:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

perks.name: Caster Frame
perks.desc:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

perks.name: Wave Sword Frame
perks.desc:
Heavy attack deploys a shockwave uppercut and launches the user into the air.
An immediate follow-up swing after the uppercut deploys a homing strike that aggressively seeks a target.

perks.name: Transcendent Duelist
perks.desc:
This weapon collects less ammo. Final blows with this weapon accelerate Light and Darkness mastery.
Deals increased damage while Transcendent; defeating targets lengthens Transcendence.
